newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF to set up new joint ventures in China.
newsitem.headline: SKF to set up new joint ventures in China.

text.p: Swedish roller bearing maker SKF AB said on Tuesday it will set up new joint ventures in China, in both bearing and seals.

In bearings, the new investments are being conducted with the Wafangdian Group, China's leading rolling bearings maker which has about 10 percent of the market corresponding to about one billion crowns, SKF said in a statement.
In seals, SKF's U.S. subsidiary Chicago Rawhide and its Chinese partner ANZAG are forming a new company to manufacture oil seals.
"These deals should be regarded a part of SKF's express strategy to capture a leading position in the Chinese market," SKF's chief executive Peter Augustsson said.
"We are expecting to see a pronounced upswing in manufacturing and sales in China."

The cooperation with Wafangdian will be launched with SKF's purchase of a strategic ownership in the Wafangdian Bearing Company (WBC). In conjunction with a new share issue, SKF will acquire about 20 percent of WBC's share capital.
The shares will be listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in Southern China.
"The intention is that SKF and WBC will then form joint-venture companies for manufacturing different types of bearings," the company said.

Most immediately, a company will be formed for the manufacturing and sales of spherical roller bearings. In this company, SKF will have a majority stake and management responsibility, the company said.
